location: Tampa, FL (on-site; in-stadium for select home matches)

fit.verdict: Strongest craft fit of the four tracked roles. 15 years of print/packaging production, brand systems, and file discipline map almost 1:1 onto the posting. Leroy already submitted a full spec matchday concept board (four production-spec print pieces + a digital match program + two partnership programmes) built specifically for this role — a serious differentiator. The one real risk is level: a 15-year founder applying to an entry-level seat reads as overqualified / flight risk / salary mismatch, and the cover letter has to address why this move makes sense.
